definitions.explanation: A player positioned in the middle of the field, linking defense and attack in soccer and other sports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧MF⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{司令塔|しれいとう}→司令塔：19809_shireitou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たしている→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: He serves as the playmaker in the midfielder role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{攻守|こうしゅ}→攻守：24059_koushu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貢献|こうけん}できる→貢献する：21682_koukensuru⟧MF⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: We want a midfielder who can contribute to both offense and defense.

notes:
MF stands for Midfielder. It is the standard abbreviation for the midfield position in soccer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{攻撃的|こうげきてき}→攻撃的：06243_kougekiteki⟧MF: attacking midfielder
- ⟦{守備的|しゅびてき}→守備的：29431_shubiteki⟧MF: defensive midfielder
- ⟦ボランチ→ボランチ：30060_boranchi⟧: defensive midfield (from Portuguese)
- ⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧: attacking midfield position
- ⟦{司令塔|しれいとう}→司令塔：19809_shireitou⟧: playmaker

ALTERNATIVE TERMS:
- ⟦ミッドフィルダー→ミッドフィルダー：06587_middofirudaa⟧: midfielder (full word)
- ⟦{中盤|ちゅうばん}→中盤：11323_chuuban⟧: midfield
- ハーフ: half (older term)

SOCCER POSITIONS:
- GK: goalkeeper
- DF: defender
- MF: midfielder
- FW: forward
